def create_resource(self, parent_id=""):
        """Create the specified resource.

        Args:
            parent_id (str): The resource ID of the parent resource in API Gateway
        """
        self.resource_id = self.client.create_resource(
            restApiId=self.api_id, parentId=parent_id, pathPart=self.path_part
        ).get("id")
